profile.name: Naazim Sanoaf
profile.tagline: Pastries, cakes and desserts, crafted with care.
profile.introduction: I’m Naazim Sanoaf, a commis pastry chef from Kalmunai, Sri Lanka. My work spans dough preparation, cake decoration and dessert presentation, drawing on experience at EL&N Café and my hometown bakery. I enjoy bringing care and creativity to every bake, working with fellow chefs and exploring seasonal ideas while keeping quality and kitchen hygiene at the heart of the process.

experience.description: Assisted senior chefs in preparing pastries, cakes and desserts, with attention to quality, taste, texture and presentation.
Managed daily baking operations, maintained quality and presentation standards, developed recipes and followed food safety practices.

reviews.name: Lily Adams
reviews.quote: As a food blogger, I’ve worked with many pastry chefs, but none have impressed me as much as NAAZIM SANOAF. His desserts are not only visually stunning but bursting with flavor. I had the opportunity to attend one of his dessert workshops, and his passion for baking and food styling is contagious. I look forward to collaborating again in the future!

reviews.name: John Edwards
reviews.quote: We hired NAAZIM SANOAF to cater a corporate event, and he exceeded our expectations. From the beautifully crafted mini desserts to the impeccable presentation of the dessert buffet, everything was perfect. His professionalism and skill were evident, and we received rave reviews from our guests. I look forward to working with him on future events.

reviews.name: Sarah Mitchell
reviews.quote: I've worked with a lot of chefs, but SANOAF's creativity and dedication to his craft set him apart. He designed a custom dessert menu for our restaurant that quickly became a customer favorite. His pastries are always on-point, and the presentation is nothing short of artistic. Highly recommend him for anyone looking for top-tier pastry expertise.
